crossRefs.note: Clouds and darkness are around him. Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.
Yes, when I cry, and call for help, he shuts out my prayer.
Yahweh God of Armies, how long will you be angry against the prayer of your people?
Yahweh said to me, “Don’t pray for this people for their good.
Then Yahweh said to me, “Though Moses and Samuel stood before me, yet my mind would not turn toward this people. Cast…
It has come to pass that, as he called, and they refused to listen, so they will call, and I will not listen,” said…

translations.web: You have covered yourself with a cloud, so that no prayer can pass through.
translations.bsb: You have covered Yourself with a cloud that no prayer can pass through.
translations.kjv: Thou hast covered thyself with a cloud, that our prayer should not pass through.
translations.asv: Thou hast covered thyself with a cloud, so that no prayer can pass through.
